gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-traditional-: Metamorphous carries a gentle stroke shift and generous sidebearings. Noto Traditional Nushu follows in broad-nibbed, sans-serif strokes that never curl shut, so the two feel like a ceremonial voice handing off to a friendly one.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-numans: Numans spaces its sans letters far apart, with s ends hanging away from the spine and a tightly coiled lowercase. Metamorphous does the grand, high-midline display work; Numans does the wide, modern running text.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-onest: Onest reads friendly, with short ascenders over big bowls and a single-nib look to every line. Metamorphous sits against it with a subdued contrast, commanding where Onest is quietly sans-serif and contemporary.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-orienta: Orienta has counters that breathe like a cut hollow reed, and its capitals sit close to the lowercase in height. And Metamorphous, with its stencil-cut letters and mildly varied bars, gives that sans-serif a distinctive, commanding lead.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-oxygen: Stately up top, open below. Metamorphous holds its curves thinning modestly at the turns, while Oxygen's sans lowercase nearly matches its capitals, so enlarging the body would quickly crowd the heading's authority.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-parkinsans: Metamorphous has the soft thick-thin shift of a lightly pressed brush, with large sidebearings all around. It is the display voice here; Parkinsans, a plain sans, stays crisp and constant like blueprint lettering.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-pathway-extreme: Pathway Extreme brings clear openings in its rounded letters and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. And Metamorphous, with light contrast between verticals and curves, keeps the longer reading feel confident but easy going.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-preahvihear: Worn charcoal, then pried oyster. Metamorphous has a slight pressure shadow and a commanding display presence; Preahvihear, a sans with a lofty x-height, simply opens its letters wide for the reading.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-prompt: Metamorphous has curved strokes that lighten mildly toward the ends, and a high-set midline. And Prompt, with its oversized small letters and open apertures, gives that display character a friendly sans-serif footing.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-pt-sans-caption: PT Sans Caption has big-bodied lowercase and bowls left inviting and unclosed. Metamorphous overhead keeps its horizontals lighter but never threadlike, so the sans below feels grounded rather than overshadowed.
